title: Hex.pm registry unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-129514, CVSS 10.0) exploited against six hex.pm servers on Nov 23
why: Hex.pm's own incident post (Nov 24) confirms an attacker ran commands on six web servers on Nov 23 via CVE-2026-129514 (GHSA-9pmm-hf4r-27pg); covered by THN and SOCRadar. Not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25) and no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Have Elixir/Erlang developers change hex.pm passwords and reset 2FA, rotate Hex API keys used in CI, fetch only from repo.hex.pm (no mirrors) until the new signed Hex client ships, and review recent releases/ownership changes on your packages.
product: hex.pm package registry service (hexpm Erlang-term request-body parser, pre-fix)

title: Drupal core installer access bypass (SA-CORE-2026-019) added to CISA KEV on Nov 27
why: No longer ahead: CISA added CVE-2026-136716 to KEV on Nov 27 (catalog 2026.11.27), after Drupal-confirmed in-the-wild exploitation reported since Nov 26.
action: Apply SA-CORE-2026-019 updates and make sure /core/install.php is not reachable on any production Drupal site; review sites for unexpected admin accounts.
product: Drupal core (sites left in incomplete/unusual installation states with the installer exposed)

title: GeoServer OWS auth bypass + WFS XML injection chain (CVE-2026-129243, CVE-2026-120705) added to CISA KEV on Nov 27
why: No longer ahead: CISA added CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243 to KEV on Nov 27 (catalog 2026.11.27), following watchTowr honeypot reports of in-the-wild probing.
action: Upgrade GeoServer to the fixed release (3.0.2 per reporting; confirm in the GeoServer advisory) and check exposed instances for compromise before patching.

title: GL.iNet GoodCloud cloud-management flaw exploited to plant malware on GL.iNet routers and KVM devices
why: GL.iNet's security notice (issued Nov 20, updated Nov 23) confirms an unauthorized party exploited a vulnerability in its GoodCloud remote-management service to install malware on some routers and KVM devices. BleepingComputer, The Hacker News, SecurityWeek and Cybernews covered it Nov 22-23; Cybernews cites researchers who found malware or older backdoors on 166 of 199 routers they analyzed. There is no CVE, it is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft signal. KVMs give the attacker a path to the connected computers. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Install the GL.iNet security firmware for each router or KVM model, check devices for the infection indicator in GL.iNet's notice, and, if a KVM was infected, check the computers connected to it.
product: GL.iNet routers and remote KVMs managed through GoodCloud (security firmware per model, e.g. GL-MT3000/MT6000 4.11.1, KVM RM1 1.10.3)

affected.product: GL.iNet GL-AX1800 / AXT1800 / SFT1200 / X3000 / XE3000 firmware
GL.iNet KVM RM1 / RM1V2 / RM10 / RM10RC / RM1PE / RM4PE firmware

title: VMware vCenter vmdir unauthenticated authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123903, 9.8): unverified public PoC claimed
why: Broadcom VMSA-2026-0011 (Nov 24) fixes a 9.8 network authentication bypass in vCenter's directory service. On Nov 24 a GitHub repository claiming a working PoC appeared (reported by The Layman Security, Rescana and Mallory; none verified it). No exploitation reported yet, not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.24). Update: Rapid7 ETR (Nov 25) validated that the public PoC achieves the authentication bypass; Rapid7 still reports no known exploitation in the wild. Rapid7 ETR (Nov 25) still reports no in-the-wild exploitation; public PoC validated. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Patch vCenter to 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300 or 8.0 U3m (VCF 5.2.5) now, and keep vCenter management interfaces off untrusted networks.
product: VMware vCenter Server 9.1.x, 9.0.x, 8.0, 7.0 (and VCF/vSphere Foundation/Telco Cloud vCenter)

title: 1Password breach: hijacked employee GitHub account used to push malicious backend code and steal customer account data and source code
why: 1Password disclosed on Nov 25 that an attacker took over an employee's corporate GitHub account, pushed malicious code to backend services and downloaded customer administrative data (names, emails, account identifiers) plus source code; BleepingComputer, The Hacker News and Cybernews report it. Vault contents and keys were not accessed, per 1Password. No CVE, not in CISA KEV, and no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Warn staff who use 1Password about phishing that mentions 1Password (fake invitations or account-recovery requests) and review 1Password business admin and activity logs for unexpected recovery or invite events.

title: Cacti 1.2.31 zero-day '4HTTP2SHELL/4HTTP2ROOT': unauthenticated RCE via guest access in four HTTP requests, public PoC, no CVE or patch
why: Researcher 'ek0ms savi0r' published a working PoC (Previdian lab-verified) for unauthenticated command execution in Cacti 1.2.31 when guest access is on; watchTowr published an advisory and THN covered it Nov 27. Still no CVE, no vendor fix, no in-the-wild exploitation reported; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Disable Cacti guest access now, restrict the Cacti web UI to admin networks, and review poller command settings for unexpected entries.
product: Cacti 1.2.31 (latest release) and likely earlier, when anonymous guest access is enabled

title: FortiOS LDAP auth-bypass (CVE-2026-22153) probe script found in an active intrusion crew's toolkit alongside Exchange, Citrix and PHP2Shell exploits
why: Hunt.io (Nov 26) recovered three open directories of an active crew that stole US hospital credentials and accessed a manufacturer's Azure storage; its kit includes fg_ldapbypass.sh, a probe for the CVE-2026-22153 FortiOS LDAP empty-password bypass, used against FortiGate SSL VPNs. CVE-2026-22153 is not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25); no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Hunt.io describes this as kit capability; no confirmed victim compromised via this CVE. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade FortiGates on 7.6.0-7.6.4 to a fixed 7.6 release per Fortinet's advisory, and review SSL VPN / FSSO logins that authenticated via LDAP with empty passwords.
product: FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.4 (Agentless VPN / FSSO policies with LDAP server configured in a specific way)

title: SAP confirms security incident: stolen employee GitHub tokens reportedly used to copy and alter source code ('Project Granite')
why: SAP confirmed the incident to BleepingComputer and The Record (Nov 27), saying it found no evidence of unauthorized access to customer business data; Der Spiegel/Handelsblatt report stolen employee GitHub tokens used to copy and alter source code and rotated signing keys. SAP has given customers no action guidance. No CVE, not in CISA KEV, no Microsoft advisory. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Watch SAP's official statements and SAP Notes for affected components or signing-key changes, verify signatures on recently downloaded SAP software and transports, and rotate any credentials or tokens shared with SAP development integrations.

title: Malicious Microsoft Store app 'Setup Assistant' (ETPS Ltd) used as backdoor to deliver Vinci RAT via fake Snipping Tool/Teams download sites
why: eSentire TRU (Nov 24) investigated a real intrusion where a Microsoft-signed Store installer pulled the 'Setup Assistant' Store app, which ran C2-supplied PowerShell/JS and deployed Vinci RAT; covered by THN, Cybernews, Brandefense, BetaNews. eSentire says Microsoft answered its Nov 10 abuse report with 'not a violation of our terms'; the app is now gone from the Store but it is unclear who removed it. No MSRC advisory or Microsoft statement seen; no CVE so not in CISA KEV. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Search managed Windows endpoints (Intune/Defender inventory) for the 'Setup Assistant' Store package from ETPS Ltd and for scheduled tasks running PowerShell every 10 minutes; isolate any hits and restrict Microsoft Store installs to an allow-list.
product: Microsoft Store app 'Setup Assistant' published by ETPS Ltd (Electron; first released June 1, 2026)

title: Rejetto HFS 3.x session forgery to unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-61500): exploited since Oct 1, used by GT13 as a relay, still not in CISA KEV
why: VulnCheck has seen exploitation since Oct 1, and GreyNoise's GT13 report (Nov 23) shows the actor took over an HFS server with CVE-2026-61500 on Oct 2 to use as its relay box. The CISA KEV catalog (version 2026.11.23, checked this run) still does not list it. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade HFS to 3.2.1 or later (or take it offline), then rotate admin credentials and check server_code settings and admin-panel logs for logins you did not make.

title: Radware Cloud WAF: exposed unauthenticated management API leaked customer log-export cloud keys (AWS S3, Azure Blob, SFTP)
why: Radware's root-cause report (via BleepingComputer, Nov 24) says an internal Cloud WAF management API was reachable from the internet without authentication and was accessed on Nov 19, exposing customer contacts and, for some customers, log-export credentials. Some customers saw AWS alerts of an unfamiliar IP probing log buckets. Hosted-service incident: no CVE, no KEV entry, nothing from Microsoft. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: If you export Radware Cloud WAF logs, rotate the S3 keys, Azure Blob keys/SAS tokens and SFTP credentials now and review storage access logs from Nov 19 on.
product: Radware Cloud WAF / AppSec (WAF, Bot) hosted service

title: Rackspace Spot breach: leaked credentials let attackers deploy pods and read customer Kubernetes Secrets; service shutting down Dec 8
why: Rackspace confirmed (BleepingComputer, SC Media) that on Nov 17 attackers used compromised credentials to deploy unauthorized pods and may have read cluster Secrets and storage files; on Nov 24 it announced Spot will be shut down Dec 8. No CVE, not in KEV, no Microsoft coverage. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Rotate every secret that was stored in Rackspace Spot clusters and look for use of those credentials since Nov 17; plan migration before Dec 8.

title: NETGEAR DGN1000 setup.cgi unauthenticated root RCE (CVE-2024-12847) still mass-exploited by Mirai/Mozi; not in CISA KEV
why: URLhaus tagged a new live malware-distribution IOC with CVE-2024-12847 this run (mirai, Mozi, php-rce); CrowdSec reports over 50,000 attacking IPs exploiting it. Still not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25); no Microsoft advisory. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Find and replace or isolate any DGN1000 routers (end-of-life hardware); block their management interface from the internet and alert on setup.cgi requests at the edge.

title: Vacron NVR board.cgi unauthenticated command injection (CVE-2025-34043) tagged on new Mozi malware infrastructure; not in CISA KEV
why: URLhaus tagged a new live malware IOC with CVE-2025-34043 this run (Mozi, php-rce, vacron); CISA's SSVC marks exploitation as PoC and automatable. Not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.25); no Microsoft advisory. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Remove Vacron NVRs from internet exposure (no vendor fix is listed) and block requests to /board.cgi at the perimeter.

title: VMware ESX I/O filter service unauthenticated network RCE (CVE-2026-123910 / CVE-2026-123911, CVSS 9.8, VMSA-2026-0011)
why: Broadcom VMSA-2026-0011 (Nov 24) fixes two 9.8 flaws (a heap out-of-bounds write and a use-after-free) in the ESX I/O filter service that an attacker with network access to the host can use to run code, with no guest VM access needed. No exploitation has been reported; not in CISA KEV. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Apply ESXi80U3m-25926933 / ESXi-9.1.2.0 / ESXi-9.0.2.0200, or the KB463535 workaround on 8.0, and limit network access to ESX management interfaces.

title: NFS2ROOT (CVE-2026-99362): pre-auth remote root in Linux kernel NFS server (nfsd, NFSv4.1 sessions), present since 3.16
why: OpenSec demonstrated a full remote-root exploit (kept private); covered by BleepingComputer (Nov 27), watchTowr FAQ and CUHK. No exploitation reported; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft advisory seen. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Update NFS server kernels to the fixed stable release for your branch and reboot; until then firewall port 2049 to trusted clients or disable NFSv4.1/4.2.

title: Trojanized official Q-Dir and DesktopOK installers (SoftwareOK) drop a Python RAT, including via the in-app update path
why: AhnLab ASEC confirmed poisoned installers served from SoftwareOK's official site and update process (reported by THN, Cybersecurity News, Nov 27). No CVE, so not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft advisory or Defender write-up seen. SoftwareOK has not published a statement in the sources seen, and how the files were swapped is unknown. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Inventory endpoints for Q-Dir/DesktopOK installed or updated recently; on any hit, check for an unexpected Python runtime and an Edge-named scheduled task running py_client_dsv2.py, and reimage rather than just uninstall.
product: Q-Dir 12.83.0.0-12.85.0.0 and DesktopOK 12.82.0.0 / 12.85.0.0 installers from the official site

title: TRENDnet TEW-751DR / TEW-733GR soap.cgi UPnP OS command injection with publicly disclosed exploit (CVE-2026-138004)
why: NVD/VulDB (VDB-444939, published Nov 27) say the exploit for the soap.cgi soapcgi_main command injection has been publicly disclosed; a companion stack overflow in wfadev.cgi (CVE-2026-138003) was published alongside. No TRENDnet advisory or fixed firmware seen, not in CISA KEV (catalog 2026.11.27).
action: Find TEW-751DR/TEW-733GR units on your networks, disable UPnP and block WAN access to their management/UPnP ports, and plan replacement since no fixed firmware is listed.

title: Spring Data Elasticsearch SpEL injection through @Query method arguments (RCE when untrusted input reaches a repository query)
why: Spring published CVE-2026-123886 (High, CVSS 8.8) on Nov 19, and NVD on Nov 23. Untrusted method arguments are evaluated as SpEL inside string-based @Query methods, which can lead to code execution. Fixed in 6.0.9 and 6.1.3. There is no public PoC or exploitation, it is not in CISA KEV, and there is no Microsoft signal. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade Spring Data Elasticsearch to 6.1.3 or 6.0.9 (the 5.x line is listed as affected through 5.5.13 with no open-source fix named) and find string-based @Query methods that take user input.

title: AutoGPT Platform ships a public default JWT secret: forge admin tokens (CVE-2026-130169, CVSS 10)
why: Disclosed Nov 23 (NVD/CVE, CVSS 10): AutoGPT Platform deployments that keep the hardcoded HS256 key from .env.default accept forged JWTs for any user or admin. VulDB lists AutoGPT 0.8.0 as the upgrade. No exploitation report found; OffSeq lists honeypot/exposure data without detail. Not in CISA KEV, no Microsoft signal. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Rotate the JWT secret in every self-hosted AutoGPT deployment (never use the .env.default value), upgrade past 0.7.4, and invalidate existing sessions.

title: Chrome critical sandbox escape in Variations (CVE-2026-134401) fixed in 158.0.8127.88; Edge fix not yet seen
why: Google shipped Chrome 158.0.8127.88/.89 on Nov 23 for a Critical-rated Variations flaw that lets a crafted HTML page run code outside the sandbox (NVD 9.6). No exploitation reported. Not in CISA KEV, and no Microsoft Edge security release or MSRC entry for this CVE was found as of Nov 24 09Z (the latest Edge security note found covers CVE-2026-125350). CERT-Bund/Fedora advisories list Edge as affected; Edge security notes still show no fix for this CVE as of last check. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Force Chrome to 158.0.8127.88+ across the fleet (relaunch required) and watch for the matching Microsoft Edge security update.

title: Joomla 6.2.1 / 5.4.11 fix 58 flaws incl. web installer authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123214) and media field RCE (CVE-2026-129393)
why: Joomla released 6.2.1 and 5.4.11 on Nov 24 with 58 security fixes (4 critical), including missing authentication in the web installer on installed sites (CVSS 9.2) and RCE through media custom field parameters (9.4). No public exploit or attacks reported yet; not in CISA KEV. A very similar Drupal installer flaw was exploited within a day of disclosure last week. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Update Joomla sites to 6.2.1 or 5.4.11 now; Joomla 4 and older sites should be moved to a supported release.

title: IkonRAT: poisoned update of an automotive-industry business app delivers Node.js backdoor and Windows credential theft
why: Blackpoint Cyber (shared via AlienVault OTX, Nov 25) reports a November 2026 supply-chain compromise: 6,438 bytes of malicious JavaScript in a legitimate app's server.bundle.js delivering IkonRAT, with follow-on UAC bypass and Windows credential theft. The affected product is not named in what we saw; no CVE, not in KEV, no Microsoft report. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Use the Blackpoint report's indicators to hunt for node.exe started by line-of-business apps making unexpected outbound connections, especially from automotive-sector software updated in November.
product: Unnamed automotive-industry business application (server.bundle.js document-rendering component)

title: WP Rocket < 3.24.2 unauthenticated path traversal rated 9.8 (Patchstack labels it RCE)
why: Published to NVD Nov 25 via Patchstack (CVSS 9.8, unauthenticated, titled RCE); widely deployed caching plugin. No PoC or ITW yet; not in CISA KEV. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Update WP Rocket to 3.24.2 or later on all WordPress sites (premium plugin: confirm the license-based auto-update actually applied).

title: HPE AirWave unauthenticated auth bypass (CVE-2026-133971) and command injection (CVE-2026-133973), CVSS 9.8, fixed in 8.3.0.8
why: HPE advisory HPESBNW05186 and NVD (Nov 25) list unauthenticated admin auth bypass CVE-2026-133971 and unauthenticated OS command injection CVE-2026-133973 in AirWave's web management interface, both CVSS 9.8, alongside authenticated SQLi and integrity flaws (CVE-2026-133974 to 133976). No exploitation or public PoC reported yet; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft signal. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade AirWave to 8.3.0.8 and restrict its web management interface to an admin network.

title: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway 15.1.2 fixes pre-auth SSTI (CVE-2026-130637, 9.3), hard-coded GINA key (CVE-2026-124843, 9.2) and account-takeover flaws
why: SEPPmail release notes for 15.1.2 and NVD (Nov 26) disclose an unauthenticated server-side template injection that discloses account data and resets passwords, plus a hard-coded fallback key that lets remote attackers forge GINA tokens. No PoC or exploitation reported. Not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade SEPPmail appliances to 15.1.2 and reset GINA account credentials if the portal was internet-exposed.

title: llama.cpp ggml RPC server unauthenticated out-of-bounds heap write (CVE-2026-137567, CVSS 9.3)
why: NVD published CVE-2026-137567 on Nov 26 (VulnCheck CNA); HOL and Brandefense write-ups say rpc-server has no authentication and anyone reaching the port can write heap memory, possibly executing code. Exploitation not confirmed. Not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft advisory or Defender coverage seen. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Update llama.cpp to b12658 or later and keep rpc-server ports on isolated networks only.

title: RealVNC unauthenticated RCE over UDP-based connections (CVE-2026-137738, CVSS 9.8); fixed in RealVNC Server 7.19.1
why: RealVNC advisory (Nov 20) and the CVE record published Nov 27 describe unauthenticated remote code execution, as root on some platforms. No public PoC or exploitation; not in CISA KEV and no Microsoft advisory. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade RealVNC Server to 7.19.1 (and viewers/apps to current releases), or disable UDP-based connections until patched.
product: RealVNC Server 6.4.0-7.19.0, Viewer 8.4.0-8.6.1, Classic Viewer 6.4.0-7.18.2, Connect App through 8.6.1, mobile viewers/servers

title: Mitel OpenScape 4000 / Manager critical command injection and auth flaws (CVE-2026-137721/137723/137724, CVSS 10); fix V11 R2.14
why: Mitel advisory MISA-2026-0013 (Nov 18) and CVE records published Nov 27: unauthenticated command injection in the Platform component. No PoC or exploitation yet, but Mitel MiCollab flaws were added to KEV on Nov 25. Not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft advisory. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade OpenScape 4000 and Manager to V11 R2.14 (or the matching V10 patch) and restrict their management interfaces to admin networks.
product: OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager V11 R0.22-V11 R2.11 and V10 (R1.68 and earlier)

title: WebRTC-based card skimmer planted on Lascana, Samsonite, American Tourister, Revolve and FWRD checkouts before Black Friday
why: InfoHawk reported Nov 27 (HN front page, multiple news aggregators) a live skimmer exfiltrating card data over WebRTC, including via Cloudflare TURN relays, from five retailers; removed Nov 24-25 after notification. Not a CVE, not in CISA KEV, no Microsoft guidance seen. Whether shoppers' cards were actually captured is unknown except a test card on Lascana. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: If you run e-commerce checkouts, audit third-party scripts on payment pages (especially pixel and cookie-banner loaders) and set a CSP that blocks unexpected RTCPeerConnection/TURN use on checkout.
product: E-commerce checkout pages loading altered third-party scripts (reported: a Quorum pixel and a Seers cookie-banner script)

title: ToolJet Helm chart ships static secret_key_base/lockbox_key: unauthenticated session forging and datasource credential decryption
why: CVE published Nov 27 with a VulnCheck advisory; the published constant key lets anyone forge sessions without auth. No exploitation reported yet. Not in CISA KEV; no Microsoft coverage. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Check ToolJet Helm installs for the default secret_key_base/lockbox_key; generate new unique keys, upgrade to 3.21.96-LTS or later, and rotate every datasource credential stored in ToolJet.
product: ToolJet deployed via the official Helm chart, before 3.21.96-LTS

title: Erlang/OTP ssl TLS 1.2/DTLS client accepts anonymous handshake: any server can be impersonated (CVE-2026-124286, CVSS 9.1)
why: The EEF CNA published the advisory on Nov 24, and fixed OTP releases are out. The flaw silently disables certificate checks for TLS 1.2/DTLS clients in Erlang/Elixir apps. No exploitation reported; not in CISA KEV. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Upgrade to OTP 27.3.4.14 / 28.5.0.9 / 29.0.3 (or the matching ssl versions); until then restrict clients to TLS 1.3 ({versions, ['tlsv1.3']}).

title: Firefox 161 / ESR 153.8 / ESR 115.46 fix multiple 9.6 sandbox escapes and memory-safety bugs
why: Mozilla advisory MFSA 2026-131 and around 50 NVD records published Nov 24, including several 9.6 sandbox escapes (Graphics/WebRender, Networking, cubeb). No exploitation reported (OffSeq: not known exploited); not in CISA KEV. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Push Firefox 161 / ESR 153.8 / ESR 115.46 and Thunderbird 161 through your software management tooling.

title: Thymeleaf restricted expression mode bypass enables template-injection RCE (CVE-2026-136410, fixed 3.1.6.RELEASE)
why: VulnCheck published CVE-2026-136410 (CVSS 9.5/9.0) on Nov 24 for GHSA-2wmw-5fmc-m25v; Ostorlab describes it as a template-injection RCE path. Not reported exploited, no public exploit seen, not in CISA KEV. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Bump Thymeleaf to 3.1.6.RELEASE (override the Spring Boot managed version if needed) and check templates for user input reaching expressions.

title: Zstandard 1.5.1-1.5.7 decompression leaks up to 64 KiB of earlier-decompressed data/uninitialized memory (CVE-2026-124851)
why: Meta published the advisory and it was posted to oss-security on Nov 24; the ZstdSharp port is still unfixed (GitHub issue #78). No exploitation reported; not in CISA KEV. Nov 28 09Z recheck: CISA KEV catalog 2026.11.27 does not list it; no MSRC entry this run.
action: Inventory services that decompress untrusted zstd input with reused contexts and update zstd (the upstream fix is in PR #5023) when your distro ships it.
product: Zstandard (zstd) 1.5.1 through 1.5.7, plus ports such as ZstdSharp
